skills.name: Calligraphy
notes: Literacy is required to write readable text; without it, letters can only be copied.

skills.name: Computer Programming
notes: Hacking without Computer Hacking has a -40% penalty; conditional hacking checks remain pending.

skills.name: Photography
notes: Computer enhancements and alterations require Computer Operation; conditional photography checks remain pending.

skills.name: Research
notes: Eyeball a Fella adds +10% when gathering information by talking to people; this conditional check remains pending.

skills.name: Performance
notes: Adds 5% to Undercover Ops and Impersonation; these target skills remain pending.

skills.name: Cryptography

additional_checks.name: After only ten minutes of study (−30%)

notes: Ordinary attempts require two hours of study; a failed attempt requires two more hours before retrying.

skills.name: Sign Language
notes: Choose deaf or military sign language. Deaf sign requires a sender and interpreter check for every twenty words and line of sight.

skills.name: Language: Other
notes: Choose a distinct language. Regional dialect penalties and cross-language comprehension remain pending; Techno-Can is a written technical language, not a spoken tongue.

skills.name: Barter
notes: Eyeball a Fella adds 10% for this Vagabond. Price negotiation rolls and rare/alien-item exceptions remain pending.

skills.name: Laser Communications
pending_prerequisites: Electrical Engineer is not yet in the reviewed catalog.

skills.name: Surveillance
notes: Electrical Engineering can substitute for Basic Electronics; that alternate skill is not yet reviewed. Complex high-tech systems also require Computer Operation and Literacy; conditional prerequisites remain pending.

skills.name: Anthropology
notes: Adds +5% to all Lore skills; these target definitions remain pending.

skills.name: Archaeology

additional_checks.name: Recognize artifacts and infer their purpose

notes: Adds +2% to all Lore skills; these target definitions remain pending.

skills.name: Artificial Intelligence
notes: Usually limited to robotics/computer specialists; eligibility beyond the current Vagabond path remains pending. Computer Hacking and its +5% synergy target remain pending.

skills.name: Chemistry: Pharmaceutical
notes: Adds +10% to Lore: Juicer; that target definition remains pending.

skills.name: Xenology
notes: Without Xenology, medical checks on an alien species have a -20% penalty. Medical species contexts remain pending; this skill does not alter ordinary First Aid checks.

skills.name: Field Surgery
notes: Emergency last-resort procedures require proper equipment. A failed attempt can kill the patient; medical simulation and Cyber-Doc exceptions remain pending.

skills.name: Forensics
notes: The Markdown heading spells Forensies; the original printed heading confirms Forensics.

skills.name: Holistic Medicine
notes: Diagnosis is the primary check; treatment is separate. Cannot perform surgery or amputation. Combined treatment contexts and +10% Identify Plants & Fruits / Preserve Food target definitions remain pending.

skills.name: Paramedic
notes: Serious injury/coma: roll three consecutive checks; two successes stabilize the patient. After failure another character may try immediately; the same character needs 1D6 minutes of reexamination. Procedure simulation remains pending.

skills.name: Medical Doctor
notes: Primary proficiency diagnoses a problem; Treatment is separate. The source animal-care penalty applies to treatment only.

skills.name: Athletics (General)
notes: Each specific Physical skill applies once. Bonuses from different skills accumulate. S.D.C. adds to separately generated starting resources.

skills.name: Body Building & Weight Lifting

source.section: Physical Skills — Body Building & Weight Lifting

notes: Adds strength and S.D.C. once; combines with other Physical skills and O.C.C. bonuses.

skills.name: Physical Labor
notes: Physical bonuses apply once and combine with other reviewed training.

skills.name: Running
notes: Physical bonuses apply once and combine with other reviewed training.
Running routine distance uses current effective P.E.; maximum-speed distance is one third of the half-speed limit.

skills.name: Boxing
notes: Natural 20: automatically knocks out an opponent for 1D6 melee rounds without announcing a knockout attempt before the strike.
Physical bonuses apply once and combine with other reviewed training.

skills.name: Swimming
notes: Surface swimming covers three times P.S. in yards/meters each melee round for P.E. minutes before fatigue. No attribute, S.D.C. or combat bonus is granted.
A failed roll leaves the swimmer afloat without covering distance. Three consecutive failed rolls cause submersion and drowning unless rescued.
Non-powered M.D.C. armor swimming requires staying afloat, depending on armor weight; no buoyancy formula is provided. Power armor swimming is permitted.

Surface swimming has the fatigue rate of running and is medium to heavy exertion, especially fast or long distances. Conditional storm and armor checks are shown separately; they do not automatically resolve simultaneous conditions or other armor movement penalties.

skills.name: Cardsharp
skills.description: Card tricks, deck manipulation, odds and card counting. Failed checks expose cheating. Cardsharp lists +4% from Palming; Palming lists +5% to Cardsharp. Use the larger overlapping bonus once (+5%), plus +6% from Gambling (Dirty Tricks).

skills.name: Computer Hacking
skills.description: Break computer access codes, trace data, bypass defenses and steal or sabotage data. Adds +5% once to Cryptography and Surveillance; Locksmith receives this bonus only for electronic/computer locks. Requires Literacy, Computer Operation, Computer Programming and at least Basic Mathematics.

skills.name: Concealment
skills.description: Hide small items on the body, in the hands or on an unaware bystander. Items must be at most 14 inches long, 6 inches wide and 10 pounds. Small, light objects receive a situational +5%.

skills.name: Find Contraband
skills.description: Locate illegal dealers and services; understand underworld practices, prices and penalties. Dealers typically pay only 20% of retail for contraband. Adds +10% to I.D. Undercover Agents.

skills.name: Gambling (Standard)
skills.description: Understand games of chance, odds and winning strategies. Knows 1D4 games plus one per two I.Q. points (round up); game count is descriptive. Adds +5% to Basic Mathematics.

skills.name: Gambling (Dirty Tricks)
skills.description: Cheat with marked cards, loaded dice, card counting and deck manipulation. Palming is required for hiding cards in the palm/sleeves and dealing from the bottom; it is not a prerequisite for the entire skill.

skills.name: I.D. Undercover Agents
skills.description: Recognize undercover law enforcement, spies, detectives, bounty hunters and other snoopers. Streetwise and Find Contraband each add +10% once.

skills.name: Imitate Voices & Sounds
skills.description: Disguise voice, accent and regional speech; separately imitate wilderness calls and sounds (36% base). Copying a specific person requires familiarity/study and has a situational -20%. Adds +5% to Impersonation.

skills.name: Palming
skills.description: Make a small object appear to vanish by concealing it in the hand. Adds +5% to Cardsharp, Concealment and Pick Pockets; Cardsharp also adds +4% to Palming.

skills.name: Pick Locks
skills.description: Open key and tumbler locks using lock-picking tools. Does not cover sophisticated computer/electronic locks. Each attempt takes 1D6 melee rounds; a failed roll leaves the lock closed.

skills.name: Pick Pockets
skills.description: Remove an item from an unaware person. Failure leaves the item in place and gives a 01-67% chance that the intended victim notices the attempt.

skills.name: Prowl
skills.description: Move quietly and carefully using balance, positioning, low visibility and crawling. Failure reveals the character; successful stealth may permit a sneak attack. Listed in both Rogue and Physical; use one identity and the Rogue entitlement for these two classes.

skills.name: Roadwise
skills.description: Know local streets, shortcuts, police posts, garages, hiding places and vehicle disposal locations in a named city/state or province. Typically reserved for car thieves, Operators and City Rats; other selections remain honor-system exceptions. Vehicle search times are descriptive.

skills.name: Safe-Cracking
skills.description: Study and open safes without harming their contents. Adds +5% to Pick Locks and Demolitions. Locksmith adds +4% and Mechanical Engineer +6% when learned. M.E. 14 or less imposes -10%. Explosive opening requires a separate Demolitions check.

skills.name: Seduction
skills.description: Influence and distract through personal attraction. Adds +1% per M.A. point over 20 and per two P.B. points over 17 (round up). Adds +5% to Cardsharp, Sing and Dance. Pick Pockets, Palming and planting things gain +5% only against a seduced victim; intoxication/drugs give a situational +5%. Victim effects are descriptive.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Recognize street gangs, ranks, colors, dangerous locations, underworld customs, drugs and their street names/prices. Adds +10% to I.D. Undercover Agents.

skills.name: Tailing
skills.description: Follow someone unnoticed and conduct basic stake-outs. Failure alerts the subject, who may evade or confront the follower. Prowl adds +5%; Tailing is also described as part of Surveillance.

conditions.text: P.E. 30+: effectively impervious to ordinary disease; virulent/designer viruses are source exceptions. Fatigue occurs at half the normal rate.
P.E. 5-7: Fatigue occurs 50% faster unless frequent rest breaks are available (Ultimate Edition p. 284).
P.E. 3-4: Fatigue occurs 50% faster unless frequent rest breaks are available. Illness and drug/poison side effects last 25% longer (Ultimate Edition p. 284).

P.E. 1-2: Fatigue occurs 75% faster unless frequent rest breaks are available. The character suffers 50% more damage; penalties and duration from illness and drug/poison/magic side effects double (Ultimate Edition p. 284).

path_guidance: City Rat related and secondary pools are class-specific. Three Physical or Rogue related choices are required, but enforcement and Hand to Hand upgrade counting remain pending.
The full O.C.C. skill catalog, complete weapon choices, category prerequisites, and class skill-pool choices outside the available catalog remain pending.
Starting P.P.E., age-22 reduction, equipment, and cybernetics remain pending.
Starting credit and Black Market item values use the separately pinned equipment rules; item identity selection remains pending.

interpretations: Overlapping Cardsharp/Palming bonuses use the larger +5% once, not +4% and +5% together.
Eyeball a Fella applies to both named Gambling forms; existing required I.D. grant retains its recorded class ability once.
The Secondary list says Gambling only; both named Gambling forms are permitted, while other Rogue skills are retained without class bonuses.
Seduction lists normal Cardsharp/Sing/Dance bonuses separately from its victim-specific theft bonuses; only the former change normal percentages.
Prowl uses the shared Rogue identity for these classes; later classes may need multi-category entitlement support.
Roadwise region is an editable specialty, with customary class restriction described rather than enforced.
